query:
SELECT b.id AS "id!: String"
           FROM blocks b
           WHERE (b.todo_state IS NULL OR b.todo_state <> 'DONE')
             AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
             AND EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM block_properties p
                 WHERE p.block_id = b.id AND p.key = 'completed_at'
             )
           ORDER BY b.id
